$schema.description: Path or URL to this JSON schema for IDE support

packageManager.description: Enable or disable package manager features. When false, miso operates as a pure script runner — no install/add/remove commands, no package.json script discovery. Default: true.

scripts.description: Path to scripts folder (relative to project root)

shell.description: Default interpreter for scripts with no shebang or recognized extension (e.g. sh, bash, zsh)

flags.description: Default flags for package manager commands (add, remove, install, dev)

oneOf.description: Orchestration mode. 'miso' (default) discovers workspace members from package.json workspaces or pnpm-workspace.yaml and fans out task execution; 'turbo' delegates to Turborepo; 'nx' delegates to Nx. Workspace membership is detected independently of this setting.

mode.description: Orchestration mode. Defaults to 'miso' if omitted.

dependsOn.description: Task dependencies. Use '^taskName' prefix to run upstream workspace dependencies first.

concurrent.description: Additional tasks to discover and run in parallel alongside the main task.

tasks.description: Per-task configuration. Available in all repo modes. Defines dependency ordering (dependsOn) and companion tasks (concurrent). In turbo/nx mode, tasks listed here use miso's direct orchestration instead of delegation.

repo.description: Orchestration mode and optional task configuration. String shorthand or object with mode and tasks. Workspace membership is auto-detected from package.json workspaces or pnpm-workspace.yaml, independent of this setting.

oneOf.description: TUI mode shorthand. 'off' disables TUI (default), 'tabbed' shows panes in separate tabs, 'merged' shows all output in a single stream.

cleanExit.description: When true, suppress log dump on TUI exit. By default, all buffered output is printed to stdout when the TUI exits.

tui.description: Multi-terminal UI mode. String shorthand or object with mode and cleanExit option.

oneOf.description: One entry per app or .env file to validate

env.description: Environment file path(s) and variable validation rules

envEntry.description: A single env file and its validation rules

scope.description: Target name this entry applies to, or "global". Required on root config entries; member configs scope by file location.

label.description: Human-readable name for this env entry (e.g. 'web', 'api'). Used in log and error output.

path.description: Path to the .env file, relative to project root (string). A legacy array is accepted; only the first element is used.

required.description: Which variables must be present: 'all' (default), 'none', or a list of specific keys

oneOf.description: Variable names mapped to type shorthands or full VarConfig objects

variables.description: Variables to validate. Array = presence only; object = type validation.

varConfig.description: Full validation config for a single variable

optional.description: If true, a missing value passes validation

min.description: string: min length. int/int+/float: min value

max.description: string: max length. int/int+/float: max value

pattern.description: Regex pattern (required for 'pattern' type; also valid on 'string')

trueValues.description: Strings treated as true for 'bool' type (default: ['true','1','yes','on'])

falseValues.description: Strings treated as false for 'bool' type (default: ['false','0','no','off'])
